result.summary: The image shows a wide signalized intersection with marked crosswalks and sidewalks. While basic infrastructure is present, the large crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend significant time in the conflict zone without a refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible to guide crossing timing at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install visible pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The street features a multi-modal design with dedicated light rail tracks and a transit platform that serves as a pedestrian refuge island. While sidewalks and marked crosswalks are present, pedestrians must navigate across both vehicle lanes and rail tracks, with parked cars potentially obscuring sight lines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Light rail tracks
hazards.description: Tracks embedded in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb on the right side of the image may block the visibility of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

result.summary: The intersection is currently impacted by construction, which has obstructed the sidewalk on one side and created a cluttered environment. While traffic signals are present, there is a notable absence of marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, increasing exposure risk for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Construction fencing and orange barriers block the primary pedestrian path on the left side of the image, potentially forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and midground along the new building

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks despite being controlled by traffic lights, which may lead to driver confusion regarding pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver yielding.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Ensure a clear, protected, and ADA-compliant path is maintained through the construction zone to prevent pedestrians from entering the vehicle travel lanes.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with integrated light rail tracks and a central boarding platform that serves as a refuge. While sidewalks and marked crosswalks are present, the long crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian signals create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of vehicle traffic and transit tracks in a single movement.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground crossing the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signalization
hazards.description: No pedestrian signals are visible to regulate the crossing across this wide, high-capacity road.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon or Signal
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-actuated signals to provide a protected crossing phase across the multi-lane roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the crossing points to reduce the total unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better driver visibility.
